10 استسعد بِهِ He deemed it, or reckoned it, fortunate, auspicious, or lucky. (K.) You say, استسعد بِرُؤْيَةِ فُلَانٍ He deemed, or reckoned, the sight of such a one fortunate, auspicious, or lucky. (S.) ―
-b2- He became fortunate by means of him, or it. (MA.) ―
-b3- He sought good fortune by means of him, or it. (MA.) ―
-b4- [And استسعدهُ He desired, or demanded, his aid or assistance: for] اِسْتِسْعَادٌ also signifies the desiring, or demanding, aid or assistance [of another]. (KL.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
